pages.text: $(l)Create: Enchantment Industry$() makes experience a $(l)liquid$(). Pipe it, store it, bottle it.$(br2)The $(l)Disenchanter$() pulls XP out of enchanted junk, the $(l)Blaze Enchanter$() spends it on enchants, and the $(l)Printer$() copies enchanted books.

A note on ethics. You will build a mob grinder. It will be efficient. You will feel nothing.$(br2)That's fine. Just don't let Olly see it.$(br2)Fill a bucket with liquid experience for the $(o)XP Farm Ethics$() advancement.
